// CASE swiftmwc_honest expect=pass
func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { try await operation(item) }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
// CASE swiftmwc_distinct_after_wait expect=fire
func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { try await operation(item) }
      }
      consume(try await group.waitForAll(), try await audit(offset))
    }
  }
}
// CASE swiftmwc_distinct_nested_group_after_wait expect=fire
func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { try await operation(item) }
      }
      consume(
        try await group.waitForAll(),
        await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { inner in await audit(offset) })
    }
  }
}
// CASE swiftmwc_distinct_in_task expect=fire
func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { consume(try await operation(item), try await audit(item)) }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
// CASE swiftmwc_nested_group_in_task expect=fire
func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask {
          consume(
            try await operation(item),
            await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { inner in await audit(item) })
        }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
